_doc: GREAT MOMENTS IN CHAT HISTORY — the proverbs register. Formalized colloquialisms as verbal tradition for imprinting (Zach's naming, joked 2026-08-19, formalized 2026-08-23). Each line is the smallest artifact that survives without custody — compression and rhyme are the checksum — so the saying travels light while the provenance stays home. Append-only; every entry carries its birth moment and lineage. The saying is the interface; this file is the freehold. SCHEMA v1.1: entries may carry 'situation' — the umbrella situation meta-tag: the class of moments in which this proverb should surface, making the saying a retrieval key that routes from lived situation -> proverb -> SSOT/receipts. A proverb without a situation is a quote; with one, it's an index.
